verdict.rationale: macOS's own docs confirm Spotlight as a built-in launcher to "search and take action without opening apps," with an "Ask Siri" top-hit option, so the core global search launcher exists. The evidence never says which content types it covers or how fast it is. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of searching files, apps, and settings specifically, evidence of instant results, the global invocation shortcut, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can search for files, apps, and settings instantly from a global search launcher

citations.quote: use Spotlight to search and take action without opening apps
when you search in Spotlight, you can choose “Ask Siri” as the top hit.
